versions.content: The SW-Component template shall support arrays of variable number of elements within the maximum size Type: valid Description: Add support for array of complex type, with variable number of elements (0 .. maxNumberOfElements). Arrays containing a variable number of data sets to access COM signal groups where only the first few signals are really available. Rationale: See Support of SAE J1939 Protocol Features Use Case: Use case: Signal modeling in DM1. Dependencies: [RS_SWCT_03180] Supporting Material: –
